Heard about this place because of the opening of Uniqlo Davao. Walked here from the Acacia or Ponciano area. Second customer. Got the iced 12oz Summer Innovator and the iced 12oz Matcha Milk from the Kid at Heart menu. There was no stock of pastries so we just took out our Wildflour cranberry walnut loaf slices. The Summer drink was interesting but I just wished it was citrus sweet like adding a satsuma. The matcha milk was okay and great that it had no clumps. It was ready to serve anyways. Overall, the prices were fair but do update your menu whenever food or drinks are out of stock.

Fourth Street coffees are a must-try for any coffee lover! ☕️ My partner and I have tried several of their options like Black, Mocha, DME, and 0104 and they were all delicious. We also got to try their Christmas Special (Matcha Latte with vanilla ice cream) and it was amazing! 📍 The café has a minimalist design that makes it perfect for early morning and late-night visits, providing a peaceful and calm atmosphere. They don't mess around with frills, just good, straightforward coffee. 👨🏻 🍳 The staff is also very friendly and helpful. On our first visit, we didn't know what to order and the barista took the time to explain the different drinks and recommend something that would suit our taste. 🏷 The price point is also great value for such good coffee. Overall, Fourth Street never disappoints. It's definitely a must-visit!

Our favorite coffee in Davao (so far!) Love the minimalist approach, the friendly baristas and the cafe's airy & relaxing atmosphere. Most affordable coffee (for us) but the taste exceeds the price! My bf and I's go-to orders are 339, Affogato, Spanish, Mocha and Matcha! Believe me when I say I was not a matcha lover before til I tasted 4th's. I'm never looking back! Pro-tip: Switch your regular milk to oat milk for just Php 20.00! More power and congrats on your new branch! Looking forward to visiting soon ☕
